v5_baseline_drift_reconciliation.root_cause_explanation: The V5 evaluation files on disk (reports/v5_full_evaluation_report.json, staging_hf_model_v5/reports/v5_full_evaluation_report.json, and reports/predictions_test_938_v5.jsonl) NEVER changed and always recorded the true V5 Quality (modified_beam_search, beam=4, bp=0.25) WERs: test_indicvoices_ur=19.69%, test_kathbath_ur=22.97%, test_rasa_ur=14.41%, test_fleurs_ur_pk=30.18%, test_csalt_voice=31.33%, test_urduspeech_benchmark_cs=39.67% (sum=158.25, unweighted macro mean=26.375% -> 26.38%). The four discrepant numbers (IndicVoices 20.37%, Kathbath 24.64%, Rasa 14.13%, FLEURS 28.14%) appeared ONLY in an ad-hoc markdown table in the assistant's chat message after conversation context compaction (<summary_content> had retained only Macro WER=26.38%, test_urduspeech_benchmark_cs=39.67%, and test_csalt_voice=31.33%, and the assistant approximated the other 4 partition cells in prose without reading reports/v5_full_evaluation_report.json). Recomputing directly from reports/predictions_test_938_v5.jsonl confirms 100% identity with the original V5 report.

fleurs_full_299_28_03_vs_28_12_reconcili.difference_pp: +0.09 pp WER (+8 word errors out of 8,460 reference words), +0.03 pp CER
fleurs_full_299_28_03_vs_28_12_reconcili.explanation: In evaluate_competitive_v6.py (logged in evaluation.log at 2026-10-26T14:48:48Z), decode_cutset_with_sherpa decoded all 299 clips of test_fleurs_ur_pk_full_299 with num_threads=2, producing 28.03% WER (2,371/8,460 word errors) and 11.96% CER, but only saved the 6 historical Test-938 partitions (which include clips 1..200 of FLEURS) into predictions_test_938_v6.jsonl. When audit_and_reconcile_v6.py first ran, it reused those 200 cached clips (decoded with num_threads=2) and decoded the remaining 99 clips (201..299) with num_threads=4. In ONNX Runtime dynamic INT8 quantization (DynamicQuantizeLinear + MatMulIntegerToFloat), changing intra_op_num_threads from 2 to 4 alters thread-partitioned floating-point reduction order on near-tied beam candidates (max_active_paths=4), shifting 8 words across the 99 extra clips. Re-decoding clips 201..299 with the standard num_threads=2 reproduces 28.03% WER / 11.96% CER.

max_new_tokens_128_truncation_audit.why_128_tokens_truncates_urdu_in_whisper: Whisper uses a byte-level GPT-2 BPE tokenizer trained primarily on Latin/English text. In Urdu UTF-8 script, each character occupies 2 bytes and typically fragments into 1.1 to 1.8 Whisper BPE tokens (roughly 5 to 7 BPE tokens per Urdu word). Consequently, any Urdu or Urdu-English utterance longer than ~20-24 words (~100-120 characters, or >= 9-12 seconds of speech) requires >124 Whisper BPE tokens and is truncated mid-sentence under max_new_tokens=128.

decoding_configurations_compared.v6_fast_mode: Streaming INT8 Transducer, greedy_search (blank_penalty=0.0, 320ms chunk, 40ms lookahead)
decoding_configurations_compared.v6_quality_mode: Streaming INT8 Transducer, modified_beam_search (max_active_paths=4, blank_penalty=0.25, 320ms chunk, 40ms lookahead)
decoding_configurations_compared.competitor_offline_greedy_mnt128: Offline full-utterance encoder-decoder, greedy_search (num_beams=1, do_sample=False, max_new_tokens=128, potentially_length_limited=True)
decoding_configurations_compared.competitor_offline_greedy_mnt440: Offline full-utterance encoder-decoder, greedy_search (num_beams=1, do_sample=False, max_new_tokens=440, untruncated)
decoding_configurations_compared.caveat: Offline competitor results use greedy decoding (num_beams=1) and are not presented as the best attainable accuracy of those models under multi-beam decoding or VAD chunking.

decoding_configuration_explicit.potentially_length_limited_note: Evaluated with max_new_tokens=128 and greedy decoding (num_beams=1). Partitions containing long (>10s) or code-switched utterances where reference transcripts exceed 120 Whisper BPE tokens are marked potentially_length_limited=True. Moreover, greedy decoding (num_beams=1) is not presented as openai/whisper-small's best attainable accuracy under multi-beam decoding or VAD segmentation.

decoding_configuration_explicit.note: Includes both default 444-token generation and max_new_tokens=128 generation; under max_new_tokens=128, 552/769 Dev cuts and 766/938 Test cuts hit the 128-token cap due to repetitive hallucination loops and Urdu BPE token length.
